description: Registration helpers for the NotionEditor MCP tools.

members.name: ToolTypes
members.description: The NotionEditor tool types, exposed for hosts that register tools by type.

members.name: AddTempoNotionMcpTools
members.description: Registers dependencies required by the NotionEditor MCP tools. The host must supply INotionDataProvider for page metadata/lifecycle tools and INotionAggregateProvider for canonical recursive reads and atomic block authoring. Hosts may implement INotionIdempotentAggregateProvider to replace the registered process-local receipt fallback with a durable transactional boundary.
